description: She wears a long rust-burgundy textured gown with a fitted bodice, low square neckline and sleeves ending near the elbows. Gold floral and geometric woven trim decorates the neckline, cuffs, front panels and hem. Round gold brooches sit near the shoulder straps. A slender gold belt with circular fastenings secures the waist. A cream wrap with burgundy and gold borders drapes around the forearms and down both sides. An ivory underdress shows through the lower front skirt opening. Gold drop earrings, a small pendant, bracelet and rings add jewelry. Patterned gold-brown shoes show below the floor-length hem.
